source_text:
Ταῦτα οὖν μετὰ τοσούτου τάχους ἐγένετο, θάττον ἢ ἐλέγετο, τῶν ὄχλων παραχρῆμα συναγόντων ἔκ τε τῶν ἐργαστηρίων καὶ βαλανείων ξύλα καὶ φρύγανα, μάλιστα Ἰουδαίων προθύμως, ὡς ἔθος αὐτοῖς, εἰς ταῦτα ὑπουργούντων.
ὅτε δὲ ἡ πυρκαϊὰ ἡτοιμάσθη, ἀποθέμενος ἑαυτῷ πάντα τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λύσας τὴν ζώνην ἐπειρᾶτο καὶ ὑπολύειν ἑαυτόν, μὴ πρότερον τοῦτο ποιῶν διὰ τὸ ἀεὶ ἕκαστον τῶν πιστῶν σπουδάζειν, ὅστις τάχιον τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ ἅψηται: παντὶ γὰρ καλῷ ἀγαθῆς ἕνεκεν πολιτείας καὶ πρὸ τῆς μαρτυρίας ἐκεκόσμητο.
εὐθέως οὖν αὐτῷ περιετίθετο τὰ πρὸς τὴν πυρὰν ἡρμοσμένα ὄργανα. μελλόντων δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ προσηλοῦν, εἶπεν: Ἄφετέ με οὕτως: ὁ γὰρ δοὺς ὑπομεῖναι τὸ πῦρ δώσει χωρὶς τῆς ὑμετέρας ἐκ τῶν ἥλων ἀσφαλείας ἄσκυλτον ἐπιμεῖναι τῇ πυρᾷ.
thought_title: The pyre is prepared and Polycarp refuses to be nailed
orientation: The crowd has just demanded that Polycarp be burned alive, and now the pyre is being prepared while Polycarp readies himself.
pass_a_gloss: These things therefore happened with such speed, quicker than it was being said, the crowds immediately gathering from the workshops and baths wood and kindling, especially the Jews eagerly, as is their custom, assisting in these things. But when the pyre was prepared, having taken off all his clothes and having loosened his belt, he tried also to take off his own shoes, not doing this before because each of the faithful was always eager, whoever might touch his skin more quickly: for in every good thing he had been adorned because of his good conduct even before his martyrdom. Immediately therefore the instruments fitted for the pyre were placed around him. But when they were about also to nail him, he said: Leave me thus: for the one who gave me to endure the fire will give me, without your security from the nails, to remain unmoved on the pyre.

choices.english: quicker than it was being said
choices.why: Keeps the passive imperfect force of the Greek, emphasizing the speed of events outpacing even the narration
Preserves the parenthetical aside about Jewish customary behavior without softening it
Pluperfect passive conveys the completed state of his adornment before the martyrdom
Renders the rare adjective with its sense of not being disturbed or shifted, fitting the context of remaining on the pyre
Keeps the noun form, referring to the security provided by the nails, rather than converting to an adjective

pass_b_english: All this happened with such speed, faster than words could tell. The crowds gathered wood and kindling at once from the workshops and the baths, and the Jews were especially eager to help, as is their custom.

When the pyre was ready, Polycarp took off all his clothes and loosened his belt. He tried to remove his shoes as well, though he had not done this before, because every one of the faithful was always eager to be the first to touch his skin. For even before his martyrdom he had been adorned with every good thing on account of his excellent way of life.

Immediately the instruments fitted for the pyre were placed around him. When they were about to nail him to it as well, he said, "Leave me as I am. The one who gives me strength to endure the fire will also give me strength to remain on the pyre without flinching, even without the security of your nails."

last_rejected.why: ἅψηται means 'touch' generally, not specifically 'skin'; 'his skin' is an over-literal rendering that sounds odd in English and misrepresents the sense of reverent contact with his person.
last_rejected.ruling: τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ ἅψηται = 'touch his skin'; χρώς means skin/surface. Rendering is accurate, not a mistranslation.

last_rejected.why: ἄσκυλτον means 'untroubled, undisturbed, not dragged about' (from σκύλλω, to harass/drag), not 'unmoved' in the sense of motionless; the point is remaining firm without being nailed, not physical stillness.
last_rejected.ruling: ἄσκυλτον means unharmed/undisturbed; 'unmoved' conveys firmness amid fire without nails. Within acceptable range, not a major error.

polish.changed: Clarified that Polycarp is the subject of the actions, smoothed the sentence order, removed the dash, and made the final speech flow naturally while preserving every claim and qualification.
